items.title: Rokka: Braves of the Six Flowers
items.reason: Across the complete 12-episode 2015 anime, six divinely selected warriors set out to stop a Demon God, but seven gather inside an activated magical barrier. The expected monster-fighting journey becomes a closed-circle impostor mystery: Adlet, suspected of being the fake, must survive pursuit and hostile allies while testing contradictory testimony, tracking clues about the barrier's activation and using traps, gadgets and deduction to counter stronger combatants. Shifting accusations, hidden loyalties, tactical confrontations, revelations about the barrier's rules and varied Saints' powers make psychological strategy and supernatural mystery more prominent than straightforward adventure. The Mesoamerican-inspired fantasy designs, magic, fiends and intermittent intense fights add distinctiveness. Limitations: most episodes remain around the temple and forest, so sustained travel and action density are modest; there is little on-screen training, power progression, systematic power explanation or graphic gore. Critics disagree whether the culprit's clues are fair or too opaque, and note sluggish middle pacing, inconsistent animation, uneven characterization and hints of romance. The final episode resolves its central impostor case but introduces another cliffhanger rather than completing the larger demon quest. This evidence concerns only the 2015 anime, not later light-novel events.
